Launcher.LocalTestHint: Available only when running solo as GM without a second player

random.Name: Random
random.Help: Randomly picks one of the ten trials

shards.Name: Shardfall
shards.Help: WASD / arrow keys · dodge crystal swarms from all directions

resonance.Name: Color Resonance
resonance.Help: WASD / arrow keys · follow the rules for line and ring waves
resonance.Teaser: Blue — hold still · Amber — keep moving

beams.Name: Resonator Beams
beams.Help: WASD / arrow keys · escape angled fans, crosses and sweeping beams
beams.Teaser: WASD / arrows · Keep moving to safe zones

gravity.Name: Gravity
gravity.Help: A/D or ←/→ · W/↑/Space jump · S/↓ fast-fall · ride platforms & dodge stalactites

timing.Name: Precision Pulse
timing.Help: Space or click inside the golden zone (tracks morph and zones drift!)
timing.Teaser: Space / click inside the golden zone

maze.Name: Crystal Maze
maze.Help: Guide the point to the golden finish with your mouse
maze.Teaser: Mouse · Grab START and reach FINISH

shield.Name: Aegis Parry
shield.Help: WASD / arrow keys · face the shield toward spears (gold spears flip!)

aim.Name: Crystal Seals
aim.Help: Click golden & armored (×2) moving seals before expiry · avoid crimson ✕ decoys
aim.Teaser: Mouse · Hit moving seals and bursts

sigil.Name: Rune Sequence
sigil.Help: WASD / arrow keys · enter the rune combo (crimson ⇄ = press opposite)
sigil.Teaser: WASD / arrows · Input the rune combo

orbit.Name: Vortex Orbit
orbit.Help: A/D or ←/→ · orbit the core and slip through inward ring gaps
orbit.Teaser: A/D or ←/→ · Slip through inward rings

endHoldMs.Name: Result display time (ms)

countdownSec.Name: Countdown (seconds)
countdownSec.Hint: How long the player has to prepare before the round starts.

masterVolume.Name: Trial volume
masterVolume.Hint: Master volume for trial sounds, from 0 to 1.

muteLocal.Hint: Mutes trial effects and music in this browser.
